thread:
Jia: rolling up polarisx v1 int8 smoke tests now, running multilang set (CJK + AR + mixed). Will post quick diffs.
Omar: ack, keep an eye on detok for vertical/furigana cases.
Jia: first oddity: Arabic brackets in Arabic+Hebrew contexts are mirrored incorrectly after int8 quant. sample:
Jia: ```
input: "مرحبا (عالم)"
baseline: "مرحبا (عالم)"
polarisx-int8: "مرحبا )عالم("
```
Lex: whoa, bracket mirror flip — looks like bidi reordering bug during detokenize step, not generation.
Sasha: repro on my laptop too with locale=ar, cheap repro snippet attached.
Jia: also seeing token fusion in mixed CJK/Latin: "北京API" -> baseline tokens [北京, API], int8 merges to [北京API] causing split errors in downstream BLEU.
Omar: what's the BLEU delta on our zh-en set?
Jia: quick numbers: baseline polarisx-fp16 -> BLEU 32.1, polarisx-int8 -> BLEU 29.4 on news-test-like set. That's large.
Sasha: any change in tokenizer config? detok script knits bytes differently under quant path?
Lex: I ran tokenmap dump, looks like map IDs shifted around subword boundary for 0xE3 ranges. Could be quant kernel reorder.
Jia: eval-bot: quality-check: flagged regression on zh->en BLEU (-8.7%), ar->en bracket-mirror spike, sample count 1200.
Omar: assign triage: @lex to kernel, @sasha to detok/directionality, @jia to repro cases and rollback plan.
Lex: starting bisect on quant kernel differences vs fp16. Will try reorder-clamp patch.
Sasha: I'll run targeted detok unit tests (bidi brackets, zwj, fullwidth) and add assert for bracket orientation.
Jia: temp mitigation: pin routing to polarisx-fp16 for those locales, and add canary test to prevent merge.
Omar: good. Add failing samples to regression suite and add note to release notes. :warning:
Jia: attaching 3 failing sample pairs below for the regression suite:
Jia: 1) zh: "北京API遇到问题" -> baseline split; int8 joins
Jia: 2) ar: "(السؤال)" -> mirrored parens
Jia: 3) mixed: "東京(مرحبا)" -> paren placement weird
Lex: started run, will update within the hour.
Sasha: thx. if we can't fix fast, consider delaying int8 rollout for multilocale groups.
Jia: agreed. ping me if you need buckets or logs. :thumbsup:
